map.AC/A（梯度法）= (加镜后隐斜 − 裸眼隐斜) / |镜片度|；AC/A（计: AC/A (gradient) = (heterophoria with lens − heterophoria without lens) / |lens power|; AC/A (calculated) = IPD(cm) + (near heterophoria − distance heterophoria) / (100 / near distance cm)
map.梯度法用加镜前后隐斜差除以镜片度；计算法以瞳距加上隐斜差除以调节需求（100/近: The gradient method divides the heterophoria difference before and after the lens by the lens power; the calculated method adds the IPD to the heterophoria difference divided by the accommodative demand (100/near distance cm) to obtain the convergence per diopter (Δ/D).
map.梯度法：AC/A = (隐斜加镜片后 − 隐斜无镜片) / 镜片度数。隐斜外隐斜: Gradient method: AC/A = (heterophoria with lens − heterophoria without lens) / lens power. Exophoria is recorded as +, esophoria as −.
map.计算法：AC/A = IPD(cm) + (近距隐斜 − 远距隐斜) / 调节需: Calculated method: AC/A = IPD(cm) + (near heterophoria − distance heterophoria) / accommodative demand (D). Accommodative demand = 100/distance (cm).
map.高AC/A是调节性内斜视的重要指标，下加光可减少调节性集合。AC/A评估需结合隐: A high AC/A is an important indicator of accommodative esotropia, and a near addition can reduce accommodative convergence. AC/A assessment should be interpreted together with heterophoria and amplitude of accommodation.
map.AC/A测量受检查方法、注视距离与镜片精度影响，临床应以规范双眼视功能检查为准。: AC/A measurement is affected by the examination method, fixation distance and lens accuracy; clinically, standardized binocular vision examination should be the basis.

map.不加镜隐斜 +3Δ（外隐斜），加 +2.00D 镜片后隐斜 −1Δ（内隐斜）→: Without lens, heterophoria +3Δ (exophoria); after adding a +2.00D lens, heterophoria −1Δ (esophoria) → AC/A=(−1−3)/2=−2... taking the absolute value 2 Δ/D; normal is about 4±2 Δ/D, and a low value suggests accommodative convergence insufficiency.
map.AC/A = IPD(cm) + (近距隐斜−远距隐斜)/调节需求(D)；IPD: AC/A = IPD(cm) + (near heterophoria − distance heterophoria)/accommodative demand (D); IPD=6 cm, difference 4Δ, accommodation 2.5D → AC/A=6+4/2.5=7.6 Δ/D, on the high side.
map.AC/A 高或低说明什么？: What does a high or low AC/A indicate?
map.高=调节易诱发集合（内隐斜倾向），低=集合不跟调节（外隐斜倾向），决定棱镜或训练: High = accommodation easily induces convergence (esophoric tendency), low = convergence does not follow accommodation (exophoric tendency); this determines the prism or training scheme.
